metadata.title: G1 pretrained MJLab walking sequence
metadata.timestampConvention: t=0 denotes first saved post-policy-step sample; original recorder saves after env.step
metadata.randomization: Original recorder disables startup domain randomization, observation noise and random pushes; seed 42

detector.source: Native MuJoCo mj_forward replay at recorded qpos/qvel/ctrl; sum nonnegative mj_contactForce normal components for foot-terrain contacts
detector.endpointConvention: Support states are [start,endExclusive); end=endExclusive-1 is the last supported sample. Graph endpoints use start and end, so every observation is a supported state.
detector.limitation: Support labels use simulator normal loads; contact detection from encoders alone requires an additional heuristic or sensor.

metadata.excludedBoundaryReason: No detected support at the initial saved sample; an unconstrained pose would be an isolated graph component.

licenseNotes.name: Policy checkpoint
licenseNotes.note: Used only by the original recorder; checkpoint and mesh assets are not distributed in this app

model.name: Unitree G1 (29 actuated joints)
model.soleDefinition: Three fixed material points on a rectangular approximation of the capsule collision sole lower envelope, expressed in ankle-roll body coordinates; not changing collision centroids.

reference.description: Recorded floating-base world poses for evaluation and optional overlay only; excluded from graph construction and optimization.

rigidity.description: Held-out reference ankle motion between stance endpoints. A perfectly rigid no-slip foot would have zero translation and rotation; this compliant gait rocks its feet.
